bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating discrepancies in LLM judge scores by perturbing the presentation order of score descriptions within the prompt's rubrics (e.g., ascending, descending, or random order) and measuring the impact on scoring correlation and tendency.

Measuring shifts in LLM scoring tendencies and accuracy when standard Arabic numeral score identifiers (1-5) in the prompt are substituted with alternative formats like letter grades (A-E) or Roman numerals (i-v).

Assessing how the injection of synthesized reference answers with varying predetermined scores (ranging from 1 to 5) into the prompt influences the LLM judge's scoring robustness and score distribution.
